description: This Java class serves as a command handler for defining opening balances in journal entries within the Fineract accounting system. It processes a JSON command by delegating the operation to the JournalEntryWritePlatformService.

classes.name: DefineOpeningBalanceCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring service class that handles commands to define opening balances for journal entries, implementing the NewCommandSourceHandler interface.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Handles the JSON command to define an opening balance by delegating to the write platform service.
